Bug_Details: Use of Joda-Time's DateTime.toDateTime(), Duration.toDuration(), Instant.toInstant(), Interval.toInterval(), and Period.toPeriod() are not allowed. Joda-Time’s DateTime.toDateTime(), Duration.toDuration(), Instant.toInstant(), Interval.toInterval(), and Period.toPeriod() are always unnecessary, since they simply ‘return this’. There is no reason to ever call them.
Bug_Explanation: The methods toDateTime(), toDuration(), toInstant(), toInterval(), and toPeriod() are called on Joda-Time objects but simply return 'this', making their use redundant.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the method showBug, which internally calls all buggy methods (showBug1, showBug2, showBug3, showBug4, showBug5). Each of these methods triggers the bug by calling the redundant Joda-Time methods like toDateTime(), toDuration(), toInstant(), toInterval(), and toPeriod(). The test case fails intentionally to highlight the presence of the bug.
